name: Incense Route - Desert Cities in the Negev
description: Scattered across Israel's Negev Desert, the ruins of Haluza, Mamshit, Avdat and Shivta mark stops on the ancient route that carried frankincense and myrrh from south Arabia toward the Mediterranean port of Gaza. Walk among the remains of houses, forts and caravan stops, and the terraced fields and water channels that let desert traders and farmers thrive for centuries.
